title: The Attestation Ladder
description: The on-chain gas cost of verifying a TEE attestation quote, across three paths: naive Solidity (~4.5M), the EIP-7951 precompile (~3.5M), and a zkVM-compressed proof (flat ~290k). Tap a bar and scale to attestations-per-day — the flat proof is the only path that survives continuous agent attestation.
controls: tap a bar (or its button) to select a verification path

dataSource.label: Automata DCAP Attestation v1.1 & Phala RiscZero zkVM verifier
